summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Ero Copper Corp. disclosing voting results from its annual general and special meeting of shareholders. The meeting covered routine items such as the re-election of directors, reappointment of auditor, approval of equity plans, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. No special situation (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change) is reported. The press release confirms all items passed with high shareholder support, with no unusual actions or events. This is a standard governance update, not a special-situation filing.
